name: TempestDecor
description: Three original dark-side-inspired home decorations honoring the Storm Tyrant and AB's Tickle Time. Cosmetic furniture without combat bonuses.
inspiration: Original Hytale homages to the hooded Sith Emperor/Palpatine lightning-casting pose, Sith holocrons and the dark-side command throne. Recognizable inspiration expressed through newly authored geometry and painted pixels. These are original Black Tempest lore objects, not claims of canonical Star Wars artifacts.

items.name: Storm Tyrant Monument
items.description: The first tyrant begged the heavens for mercy. This one raised ten fingers and demanded their obedience. Obsidian robes shelter a heart of captive thunder; carved violet arcs preserve the moment the storm learned whom to hate. An original dark-side storm-caster homage. Cosmetic decoration.
sourceLoreAnchors: Commanded heavens and the storm without conscience
Ten promises of agony; the first crack is thunder
items.visualBrief: Carved hooded Emperor-like storm tyrant, original shadowed angular face, both hands raised with ten articulated fingertips and short static jagged violet-blue lightning filigree; obsidian robes, engraved captive chest core, named-stone pedestal. Deliberately a sculpted tyrant, not an armor mannequin. Composed front and reverse detail.

items.name: Captive Storm Holocron
items.description: A pyramidal prison holds the storm's final lesson: mercy is a door that opens only once. Ten etched paths converge on a violet heart, recalling the fingers that taught thunder its cruelty. Its secrets remain a silent display. An original homage to Sith holocrons; decorative light only.
sourceLoreAnchors: Ten little promises from the fingertips
items.visualBrief: Unmistakable stepped pyramidal dark-side holocron in a diagonal blackened-metal cage on a compact pedestal. Exposed faceted violet core, triangular etched seals, ten small engraved channels, purposeful rear composition. Frozen geometry; no animated lightning or damage.

items.name: Throne of Black Dominion
items.description: No surrendered name was ever spoken from this throne. Blackened ribs rise around the place where a sovereign commanded the heavens, and violet seams keep the debt of every storm that answered. An original dark-side command-throne homage. Interact to sit; no combat bonus.
sourceLoreAnchors: Every channel etched with a surrendered name
Its owner will never again kneel
The storm collects what it is owed
items.visualBrief: Severe angular dark-side command throne, high segmented back with hood/V-crown crest, blackened ribbed armrests, inset violet fittings, layered stitched midnight cloth, engraved reverse back and plinth. Original sculptural furniture with normal Hytale chair sitting.
